verdict.rationale: Egnyte's own docs describe streaming large files in blocks so desktop applications like AutoCAD and Revit can open them directly from cloud storage, with predictive streaming loading what is needed first. That amounts to on-demand file access through Egnyte's own capability. Nothing in the pack names official macOS or Windows desktop sync clients or a selective-sync feature. Missing for 10: documented official desktop clients for macOS and Windows, selective sync, an explicit online-only/files-on-demand placeholder mode, and independent or hands-on corroboration of sync reliability.

support.subject: As a power user, sync just works on my machines — official desktop clients across macOS/Windows with selective sync and on-demand (online-only) files

citations.quote: streams only large files in blocks, enabling large CAD and BIM files to open at full speed in AutoCAD, Revit, and other desktop applications from cloud storage without the long delays.
Predictive streaming loads what’s needed first, so projects keep moving.
Ability to work in the cloud with desktop and browser based applications including Autodesk, Adobe, Esri, Bentley, and more.
